side.source: Parkers 2025 Porsche 911 Carrera T 992.2 near-orthographic side image
side.allowed_transfer: 992.2 coupe body-shell silhouette / greenhouse / wheel-arch relationship only
side.forbidden_transfer: Carrera T graphics, trim, exact fascia package, production surface patch layout

front.source: Elferspot 2025 Porsche 992.2 Carrera front studio image
front.allowed_transfer: front proportion / cabin-to-body width / lamp-fender relationship

rear.source: Eurocar Porsche 911 Carrera 992 II rear studio image
rear.allowed_transfer: rear shoulder / greenhouse / lightbar / lower-mass relationship

side_calibration.x_mapping: piecewise linear through rear extreme -> rear axle -> front axle -> front extreme

z_mapping.method: official height + public front tyre OD constraint

segmentation.method: largest connected near-neutral bright body component within bounded vehicle crop; median-smoothed top envelope
segmentation.threshold_note: calibration aid only; target remains visual evidence, not measured CAD

front_normalized_targets.note: ratios measured from the largest main-vehicle component in the front reference; mirrors excluded from the primary body ratio
